title: Loading Regulations
previewText: The provisions of the underlying loading regulations shall be modified so that in C4-2 Districts, the loading requirements applicable to C4-4 Districts, as set forth in Article III, Chapter 6 (Accessory Off-Street Parking and Loading Regulations), shall apply.
